'''2011 German National Championship Ziemowit Skwara LS Watch Your Step (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Ziemowit Skwara]] at [[2011 German National Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Watch Your Step (V) / This Place Can Be A Little Rough (V)|VB4-L-watchyourstep-pre.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Ziemowit Skwara "Kryptofis"
* '''Deck name:''' WYS(v)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.3]]
